data: In fiscal 2024 (the year ended September 28, 2024), Apple reported net sales of about $391.04 billion, gross profit of about $180.68 billion, and operating income of about $123.22 billion. That works out to a gross margin of roughly 46.2% ($180.68B / $391.04B) and an operating margin of roughly 31.5% ($123.22B / $391.04B). Gross margin improved from about 44.1% in fiscal 2023, helped by a richer mix toward Services, while operating expenses were about $57.47 billion for the year. These figures are from memory of Apple's 10-K, so verify them against the filing if you need exact numbers.
